sections.heading: Ingredients
items: Sesame seeds, lightly toasted in ungreased fry pan
Make diagonal slice in center of each won ton skin about 2 inches. Then fold each of the remaining two corners through center slice.
Deep fry each won ton skin in wok until golden brown; then drain.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, 4 Tbl. melted butter mixed with 1 Tbl. almond extract, and finally sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Soak the rice in water for an hour then add more water and cook the rice until the water goes down.
Add the lard and sugar to the hot rice, mix well, and set aside.

Grease a big bowl with lard and arrange candy fruit in the bottom of the bowl. Add some to the top of the fruit until the fruit is covered. Make a hole in the rice and add the bean paste to the hole and then cover with the rest of the rice.
Place the bowl in the steamer and steam for 1 hour. Remove the mold to a serving platter.

Bring the water and sugar almost to the boiling point then add the milk. Thicken the mixture with the cornstarch and then add the cinnamon. Pour the sauce over the fruit-rice mold and serve immediately.

sections.heading: Note
items: You may use any type of dry candied fruit such as candied lotus seeds, red dates, peanuts, raisins, cherries, walnut halves, squash candy, candied orange peels, etc.
Combine ingredients in Mixture A and knead the dough thoroughly until it is nice and smooth.
Roll the dough out flat to about 1/6 inch thickness and cut into very thin strips. Lightly powder the noodles with flour.
Deep fry the noodles in very hot oil until a light golden brown. Drain them and set aside.

Bring Mixture B to a boil. After the sugar has melted, let it simmer on low heat for 10 minutes. Pour the hot syrup over the noodles and mix well. Place the glazed noodles on a flat surface and shape into a 9x9x2 inch cake. Sprinkle Mixture C over it, and when it has cooled, cut into small squares and serve as a dessert.
Sift flour and baking powder together. Add lard and sugar. Add water. Knead the dough thoroughly until it is smooth.
Cut the dough into 15-20 small pieces. Flatten them with your hand and roll them into 2 inch round pancakes. Brush sesame oil on half and fold other half over into a half moon shape.
Use knife to make marks on top of the bun and place the bun in steamer and steam for 4-5 minutes.
